title: Core Artifact: evidence.json
description: Contract for a single evidence artifact in s3://onc-compbio/core-artifacts/{indication}/{gene}/{dimension}/evidence.json. Produced ONCE by a batch/ job (compute), read MANY times by skills (retrieval). This is the lingua franca consumed by AgenticBoost and the knowledge graph. Refines omics_evidence.rna_expression from workflow-target-evaluation-onc/reference/evidence_extraction_schema.yaml.

gene.description: Official HGNC gene symbol, e.g. SCD1.

indication.description: Indication slug, e.g. crc, nsclc, pdac.

dimension.description: Analysis dimension (one of the 8 in the runbook).

computed_date.description: Date the batch job produced this artifact (ISO 8601).

provenance.description: Where the inputs came from and how this was computed. Mirrors the runbook's provenance.yaml contract. The catalog_refs link back to data-catalog manifest IDs — this is what makes the artifact traceable to a re-obtainable source.

source.description: Human-readable source label, e.g. 'TCGA COAD/READ + GTEx colon'.

release.description: Source release/version string, e.g. 'GDC Data Release 42' or 'OncoLand b38_gc33'.

method.description: Computation method, e.g. 'Tumor vs adjacent-normal DGE, Mann-Whitney, BH-FDR Tier 1'.

git_commit.description: Commit SHA of the batch code that produced this artifact.

parameter_hash.description: Hash of the parameter set (config) used, for staleness/repro checks.

catalog_refs.description: data-catalog manifest IDs of the datasets this artifact derived from. e.g. ['tcga-gdc-dr42', 'gtex-v10']. THIS is the lineage link back to a re-obtainable source.

result.description: The dimension-specific result payload. Required keys vary by dimension; for expression, see the expression-dimension keys below. Open object so each dimension defines its own result shape, but values must be JSON scalars/arrays (no nested compute state).

summary.description: One-to-three sentence human-readable interpretation. Directional language, not a computed score (ScholarEval-style scores are dropped per runbook).

confidence.description: Directional confidence rating, per runbook (replaces ScholarEval numeric score).

label.description: REQUIRED per runbook. 'pre-specified' = standard workflow, suitable for BLF. 'exploratory' = non-default parameters, hypothesis-generating only.

staleness.description: Release-based staleness, NOT time-based (per runbook). Stale when the source release in provenance no longer matches the canonical current release.

$comment: Expression-dimension result keys (when dimension=expression) SHOULD include: tumor_vs_adjacent_log2fc, tumor_vs_adjacent_pvalue, tumor_vs_adjacent_padj, tumor_median_log2tpm, normal_median_log2tpm, gtex_normal_log2tpm, n_tumor_samples, n_normal_samples, detection_rate. These mirror omics_evidence.rna_expression in evidence_extraction_schema.yaml v1.1.0.
